### Test unilatéral à gauche

```{r fig.width=14, fig.height=15, out.width="100%"}
#| label: student_distrib_fig
#| fig-cap: "Régions d'acceptation et de rejet d'un test de Student, illustrées par une distribution avec 10 degrés de liberté. Gauche : fonction de densité. Droite : function de répartition (Cumularive Distribution Function). Vert : régions d'acceptation ; rouge : régions de rejet. Haut : test bilatéral ; milieu : test unilatéral à droite ; bas : test unilatéral gauche. "
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7

## Panel configuration
par(mfrow=c(3,2))


## Parameters
alpha <- 0.05
df <- 10
t_threshold <- abs(qt(p = alpha, df = df))
x <- seq(from=-4, to=4, by=0.01)
dens <- dt(x, df = df) ## Density
cdf <- pt(x, df = 10, lower.tail = TRUE) ## Cumulative density function

## Two-tailed test, density
plot(x, 
     dens, 
     main = paste0("Density, bilateral test"),
     xlab = "t",
     ylab = "d(t)",
     type='l', 
     col = "blue",
     las = 1)
grid()
x_up = seq(from=t_threshold, to = 4.0, by=0.01)
x_mid = seq(from=-t_threshold, to = t_threshold, by=0.01)
x_down = seq(from=-4.0, to = -t_threshold, by=0.01)
lines(x_up, dt(x_up, df = df), type = "h", col = "red")
lines(x_mid, dt(x_mid, df = df), type = "h", col = "#00BB00")
lines(x_down, dt(x_down, df = df), type = "h", col = "red")
abline(v=0)
abline(v = c(-t_threshold, t_threshold),   col = "red")

## Two-tailed test, CDF
plot(x, 
     cdf, 
     main = "CDF, bilateral test",
     xlab = "t",
     ylab = expression(P(T <= t)),
     type='l', 
     col = "darkviolet",
     las = 1)
grid()
abline(v=0)
abline(v = c(-t_threshold, t_threshold),  col = "red")
arrows(x0=-4, x1 = -t_threshold, y0 = 0.2, y1 = 0.2, col = "red", length = 0.1, code = 2, lwd = 2)
arrows(x0=t_threshold, x1 = 4, y0 = 0.8, y1 = 0.8, col = "red", length = 0.1, code = 1, lwd=2)
arrows(x0=-t_threshold, x1 = t_threshold, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5, col = "#00BB00", length = 0.1, code = 3, lwd=2)


## Right-sided test, density
plot(x, 
     dens, 
     main = paste0("Density, right-sided test"),
     xlab = "t",
     ylab = "d(t)",
     type='l', 
     col = "blue",
     las = 1)
grid()
x_reject = seq(from=t_threshold, to = 4.0, by=0.01)
x_accept = seq(from=-4, to = t_threshold, by=0.01)
lines(x_reject, dt(x_reject, df = df), type = "h", col = "red")
lines(x_accept, dt(x_accept, df = df), type = "h", col = "#00BB00")
abline(v=0)
abline(v = t_threshold,   col = "red")

## Right-sided test, CDF
plot(x, 
     cdf, 
     main = "CDF, right-sided test",
     xlab = "t",
     ylab = expression(P(T <= t)),
     type='l', 
     col = "darkviolet",
     las = 1)
grid()
abline(v=0)
abline(v = t_threshold,  col = "red")
arrows(x0=-4, x1 = t_threshold, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5, col = "#00BB00", length = 0.1, code = 2, lwd=2)
arrows(x0=t_threshold, x1 = 4, y0 = 0.8, y1 = 0.8, col = "red", length = 0.1, code = 1, lwd=2)


## Left-sided test, density
plot(x, 
     dens, 
     main = paste0("Density, left-sided test"),
     xlab = "t",
     ylab = "d(t)",
     type='l', 
     col = "blue",
     las = 1)
grid()
x_reject = seq(from = -4, to = -t_threshold, by = 0.01)
x_accept = seq(from = -t_threshold, to = 4, by = 0.01)
lines(x_reject, dt(x_reject, df = df), type = "h", col = "red")
lines(x_accept, dt(x_accept, df = df), type = "h", col = "#00BB00")
abline(v=0)
abline(v = t_threshold,   col = "red")

## Left-tailed test, CDF
plot(x, 
     cdf, 
     main = "CDF, left-sided test",
     xlab = "t",
     ylab = expression(P(T <= t)),
     type='l', 
     col = "darkviolet",
     las = 1)
grid()
abline(v=0)
abline(v = -t_threshold,  col = "red")
arrows(x0=-4, x1 = -t_threshold, y0 = 0.2, y1 = 0.2, col = "red", length = 0.1, code = 2, lwd = 2)
arrows(x0=-t_threshold, x1 =4, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5, col = "#00BB00", length = 0.1, code = 1, lwd=2)


```



### Tableau de valeurs critiques bilatérales de la distribution de Student

```{r}
#| label: tbl-student-bilateral
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Probabilités bilatérales indiquées en tête de colonne
alpha <- c(0.90, 0.50, 0.30, 0.20, 0.10,
           0.05, 0.02, 0.01, 0.001)

# Degrés de liberté
ddl <- 1:30

# Valeurs critiques : P(|T| >= t) = alpha
student_values <- outer(
  ddl,
  alpha,
  FUN = function(nu, a) qt(1 - a / 2, df = nu)
)

# Limite pour un nombre infini de degrés de liberté :
# distribution normale centrée réduite
normal_values <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)

student_table <- rbind(
  student_values,
  normal_values
)

# Affichage avec trois décimales et virgule décimale
student_table <- apply(
  student_table,
  c(1, 2),
  function(x) {
    sub(
      "\\.",
      ",",
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  }
)

student_table <- data.frame(
  "d.d.l." = c(as.character(ddl), "\u221e"),
  student_table,
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(student_table)[-1] <- c(
  sub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", alpha[-length(alpha)])),
  sub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.3f", alpha[length(alpha)]))
)

knitr::kable(
  student_table,
  align = c("r", rep("r", length(alpha))),
  caption = paste0(
    "Valeurs de $t$ telles que ",
    "$P(|T_\\nu| \\geq t)=\\alpha$."
  ),
  booktabs = TRUE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE
)
```
